## Preprints {#preprints}

::: {.publication}
<span class="pub-index">01</span>

### Quantum invariance under non-smooth toric flops of the simplest type

**Tsung-Chen Chen**, **Jia-Hua Chong**, **Hui-Wen Lin**. 2026. Preprint.

For a non-smooth toric flop of the simplest type, we provide the quantum product formulas and construct the degree-preserving quantum correspondence via generalized analytic continuation which is achieved through a regularization map. Moreover, the generating functions of Gromov--Witten invariants with ancestors are invariant for all genera.

[PDF](#){.pub-link} [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.24066){.pub-link} [Code](#){.pub-link}
:::
